dashboard.label: MCP Security Posture
dashboard.description: OWASP MCP Top 10:2025 beta findings from mcpsec scans. Queries expect HEC events with sourcetype mcpsec:finding, where the indexed event is the OCSF object.

search.query: index=mcpsec sourcetype=mcpsec:finding | spath output=severity path=severity | stats count by severity | sort -count

index=mcpsec sourcetype=mcpsec:finding | spath output=rule_id path=finding.uid | spath output=owasp path=unmapped.owasp_mcp | rex field=rule_id "^(?<prefix>MCP\d{2})" | eval owasp=coalesce(owasp, prefix) | eval category=case( owasp="MCP01", "MCP01 Token Mismanagement", owasp="MCP02", "MCP02 Scope Creep", owasp="MCP03", "MCP03 Tool Poisoning", owasp="MCP04", "MCP04 Supply Chain", owasp="MCP05", "MCP05 Command Injection", owasp="MCP06", "MCP06 Intent Flow", owasp="MCP07", "MCP07 Authentication", owasp="MCP08", "MCP08 Audit and Telemetry", owasp="MCP09", "MCP09 Shadow MCP", owasp="MCP10", "MCP10 Context Over-Sharing", true(), "Other" ) | stats count by category | sort -count
index=mcpsec sourcetype=mcpsec:finding | spath output=server_name path=resources{}.name | stats count by server_name | sort -count | head 10

index=mcpsec sourcetype=mcpsec:finding | spath output=rule_id path=finding.uid | spath output=title path=finding.title | spath output=description path=finding.desc | spath output=severity path=severity | spath output=owasp path=unmapped.owasp_mcp | spath output=server_name path=resources{}.name | table _time, rule_id, owasp, title, severity, server_name, description | sort -_time | head 50
